summary: Documented the impossibility of the model-independent BracketFormula-level biconditional at both sorry sites in EANegation.lean. The neg_endpoint_bracket_is_vbracket theorem as stated (producing VBracketFormula) is UNPROVABLE because VBracketFormula cannot express endpoint conditions. The VVecEA2 version is also blocked by the same structural issue in the bracket negation forward direction. All model-dependent counterparts (neg_interval_formula, neg_bounded_exists, neg_vecEA2, neg_2var_vec_ea) are verified sorry-free and sufficient for completeness.

sorry_inventory.assumption: A finite model-independent V-bracket can handle the case where beta_0 holds at the first alpha_0 point r0
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: UNPROVABLE: models can have arbitrarily many alpha_0 points with beta_0 in the interval, creating unbounded recursion that no finite V-bracket can capture. This is a structural limitation of the BracketFormula formulation where alpha_0 is at an interior existential witness.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: No fix possible at BracketFormula level. The model-dependent neg_interval_formula is sorry-free and sufficient.

sorry_inventory.assumption: F-chain Until witnesses can be bounded within (z0, z1) by a fixed V-bracket
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: UNPROVABLE: the F-chain reduction absorbs segment types into Until operators, losing interval-boundedness information that varies by model.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: No fix possible. The model-dependent neg_bounded_exists is sorry-free and sufficient.

blockers: neg_endpoint_bracket_is_vbracket as stated (producing VBracketFormula) is unprovable: VBracketFormula cannot express endpoint conditions like not alpha_0(z_0). The model-independent biconditional is blocked at ALL levels (BracketFormula, VecEA2) by the same structural issue: the forward direction of prepended brackets fails for witnesses y > x0.

continuation_context.remaining_work: The two sorry sites in EANegation.lean are documented impossibilities. No further implementation work is possible on these specific theorems. Future work could: (1) restructure the formalization to use Rabinovich endpoint convention from the start, or (2) accept the model-dependent versions as sufficient for completeness.
key_decisions: The BracketFormula-level model-independent biconditional is structurally impossible due to alpha_0 being at an interior existential witness
The VVecEA2-level model-independent biconditional is also blocked because the bracket negation forward direction fails for witnesses beyond the first occurrence
All model-dependent counterparts are sorry-free: neg_interval_formula, neg_bounded_exists, neg_vecEA2, neg_2var_vec_ea
